transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with this constant, uncontrollable worry about almost everything in my life. It's been going on every single day for about a year and a half now, and I'm just so exhausted.
Do you also have symptoms like restlessness, muscle tension, trouble concentrating, irritability, or sleep problems along with the worry?

I definitely have a really hard time concentrating because worries will suddenly pop into my head and completely disrupt my focus while I'm trying to get things done. However, I haven't really noticed or experienced the other symptoms you mentioned, like restlessness, muscle tension, irritability, or sleep problems.
How much has this worry been affecting your work, school, or daily life?

It has been affecting my daily life a lot because worries about my work, family, and finances constantly pop into my head out of nowhere. This constant distraction makes it incredibly hard to focus on my tasks or get anything done during the day.
Do you feel the worry is difficult to control most days, even when you try to stop or reassure yourself?

Yes, it is incredibly difficult to control and it happens almost every single day. Even when I try to distract myself or tell myself that everything will be fine, I just can't seem to stop the thoughts from completely taking over.

opening_question.question: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports excessive, uncontrollable worry about multiple life areas (work, family, finances) occurring nearly every day for about 1.5 years, with difficulty controlling the worry and significant impairment in daily functioning. Associated symptoms include concentration problems; he denies restlessness, muscle tension, irritability, and sleep disturbance. The chronic, pervasive nature of the worry most strongly supports Generalized Anxiety Disorder.
